content: 1. Posaconazole can increase digoxin levels by reducing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 2. Posaconazole significantly increases the levels or effects of dihydroergotamine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 3. Posaconazole also increases the levels or effects of intranasal dihydroergotamine via CYP3A4 inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 4. Posaconazole increases diltiazem levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Both disopyramide and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use an alternative therapy due to the risk of serious cardiac effects. 6. Posaconazole increases disopyramide levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. The significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 7. Posaconazole increases docetaxel levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 8. Both dofetilide and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 9. Both dolasetron and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 10. Both donepezil and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 11. Posaconazole increases donepezil levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 12. Posaconazole increases doravirine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 13. Co-administration of doravirine with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase doravirine plasma concentrations and toxicities. Monitor closely. 14. Both doxepin and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 15. Posaconazole increases dronabinol levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Dronabinol is a CYP3A4 substrate, and its levels may be affected by posaconazole. Monitor closely. 17. Both dronedarone and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use an alternative therapy due to the risk of serious cardiac effects. 18. Dronedarone increases posaconazole levels or effects via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 19. Combining dronedarone with other QT-prolonging medications is contraindicated. Avoid this combination. 20. Posaconazole increases dronedarone levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 21. Both droperidol and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 22. Posaconazole increases dutasteride levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 23. Posaconazole increases duvelisib levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 24. Reduce the duvelisib dose to 15 mg twice daily when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 25. Posaconazole increases edoxaban levels or effects via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 26. Dose adjustments may be required for edoxaban when used with strong P-glycoprotein inhibitors. For DVT/PE treatment, reduce the dose to 30 mg once daily. No dose reduction is recommended for NVAF. 27. Both efavirenz and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is contraindicated. 28. Posaconazole increases efavirenz levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 29. Posaconazole increases elacestrant levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 30. Elagolix increases posaconazole levels or effects via P-glycoprotein inhibition, and posaconazole increases elagolix levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 31. Co-administration of elagolix 200 mg twice daily with strong CYP3A inhibitors for more than one month is not recommended. Limit elagolix to 150 mg once daily for up to six months if co-administered. 32. Posaconazole increases elbasvir/grazoprevir levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 33. Posaconazole increases eletriptan levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 34. Posaconazole increases eliglustat levels or effects via CYP3A4 inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 35. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors are contraindicated with eliglustat in poor or intermediate metabolizers. Reduce the eliglustat dose to 84 mg once daily in extensive metabolizers. Avoid eliglustat if strong or moderate CYP2D6 inhibitors are used with strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors. 36. Eliglustat increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 37. Both eliglustat and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is contraindicated. 38. Posaconazole increases elvitegravir levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 39. Elvitegravir is a CYP3A4 substrate, and its levels may increase with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Monitor closely. 40. Posaconazole increases elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 41. Posaconazole increases encorafenib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the encorafenib dose to one-third of the original dose. 42. Both encorafenib and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 43. Posaconazole increases enfortumab vedotin toxicity via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 44. Enfortumab vedotin is metabolized by CYP3A4, and co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase toxicities. Monitor for signs of toxicity. 45. Posaconazole increases entrectinib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 46. Avoid co-administration of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors with entrectinib, a CYP3A4 substrate. 47. Both entrectinib and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 48. Posaconazole increases enzalutamide levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 49. Both epinephrine and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 50. Both racemic epinephrine and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 51. Posaconazole increases eplerenone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 52. Posaconazole increases erdafitinib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, monitor closely for adverse reactions and consider dose adjustments. 53. Both ergotamine and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 54. Posaconazole increases eribulin levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 55. Posaconazole increases erlotinib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 56. Both erythromycin base and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 57. Posaconazole increases erythromycin base levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 58. Both erythromycin ethylsuccinate and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 59. Posaconazole increases erythromycin ethylsuccinate levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 60. Both erythromycin lactobionate and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 61. Posaconazole increases erythromycin lactobionate levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 62. Both erythromycin stearate and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 63. Posaconazole increases erythromycin stearate levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 64. Posaconazole increases escitalopram levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Escitalopram increases posaconazole toxicity via QTc prolongation. Use caution and monitor closely. 65. Posaconazole increases esomeprazole levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Esomeprazole decreases posaconazole levels by increasing gastric pH. Use caution and monitor closely. This interaction applies only to oral forms of both agents. 66. Posaconazole increases estradiol levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 67. Posaconazole increases estradiol vaginal levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 68. Co-administration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase estrogen plasma concentrations and toxicities. Monitor closely. 69. Posaconazole increases conjugated synthetic estrogens levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 70. Posaconazole increases esterified estrogens levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 71. Posaconazole increases estropipate levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 72. Posaconazole increases eszopiclone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 73. Posaconazole increases ethinyl estradiol levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 74. Posaconazole increases ethosuximide levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 75. Ethotoin decreases posaconazole levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 76. Posaconazole increases etonogestrel levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 77. Posaconazole increases etoposide levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 78. Posaconazole increases etravirine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 79. Posaconazole increases eucalyptus levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 80. Posaconazole increases everolimus levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 81. Both ezogabine and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Slight and transient QT prolongation has been observed with ezogabine, particularly at high doses. Monitor the QT interval when co-administered with QT-prolonging agents. 82. Famotidine decreases posaconazole levels by increasing gastric pH. Use caution and monitor closely. This interaction applies only to oral forms of both agents. 83. Posaconazole increases fedratinib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the fedratinib dose to 200 mg/day. 84. Posaconazole increases felbamate levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 85. Posaconazole increases felodipine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Felodipine increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 86. Posaconazole increases fentanyl levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is necessary, monitor for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust the fentanyl dose as needed. 87. Posaconazole increases fentanyl intranasal levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is necessary, monitor for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust the fentanyl dose as needed. 88. Posaconazole increases fentanyl transdermal levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is necessary, monitor for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust the fentanyl dose as needed. 89. Posaconazole increases fentanyl transmucosal levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is necessary, monitor for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust the fentanyl dose as needed. 90. Posaconazole increases fesoterodine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 91. Posaconazole decreases fexinidazole levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, monitor for decreased efficacy due to reduced plasma concentrations of active metabolites. 92. Posaconazole increases finasteride levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 93. Posaconazole increases finerenone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 94. Both fingolimod and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 95. Both flecainide and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 96. Posaconazole increases flibanserin levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. Co-administration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors can cause severe hypotension or syncope. 97. Both fluconazole and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 98. Posaconazole increases fludrocortisone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 99. Posaconazole increases flunisolide inhaled levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 100. Both fluoxetine and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 101. Both fluphenazine and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 102. Posaconazole increases flurazepam levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 103. Posaconazole increases flutamide levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 104. Posaconazole increases fluticasone furoate levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 105. Posaconazole increases fluticasone inhaled levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 106. Posaconazole increases fluticasone intranasal levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase systemic corticosteroid adverse effects. Monitor for signs of high corticosteroid concentrations, including Cushing-type symptoms. 107. Both fluvoxamine and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 108. Food increases posaconazole levels by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Co-administration with a high-fat meal is recommended. 109. Both formoterol and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 110. Fosamprenavir decreases posaconazole levels by an unknown mechanism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. This combination may reduce posaconazole plasma concentrations. Monitor for breakthrough fungal infections if co-administered. 111. Posaconazole increases fosaprepitant levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 112. Both foscarnet and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 113. Fosphenytoin decreases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition and increased metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 114. Fostamatinib increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole also increases fostamatinib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Monitor for toxicities that may require dose reduction. 115. Posaconazole increases futibatinib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Co-administration with dual P-glycoprotein and strong CYP3A inhibitors may increase futibatinib toxicities. 116. Posaconazole increases ganaxolone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 117. Posaconazole increases gefitinib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase the risk of gefitinib adverse effects. 118. Both gemifloxacin and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 119. Posaconazole decreases gentamicin levels by an unknown mechanism. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 120. Posaconazole increases gepirone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. Both gepirone and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 121. Posaconazole increases gilteritinib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, monitor closely for gilteritinib-related adverse effects. Both gilteritinib and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 122. Posaconazole increases glasdegib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Consider alternative therapies that are not strong CYP3A inhibitors or monitor for increased risk of adverse effects, including QTc prolongation. 123. Posaconazole increases glecaprevir/pibrentasvir levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Glecaprevir/pibrentasvir increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 124. Posaconazole increases glimepiride levels by decreasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 125. Posaconazole increases glipizide levels by decreasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 126. Posaconazole increases glyburide levels by decreasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 127. Both granisetron and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 128. Posaconazole increases guanfacine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors significantly increase guanfacine plasma concentrations. For extended-release guanfacine, reduce the dose to half the recommended dose if co-administered. Specific recommendations for immediate-release guanfacine are not available. 129. Both haloperidol and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely.
